coaching.headline: Structure pressure won the game: eleven structures taken to four, and the closing fights after Orb Prime ran straight into the Core.

flags.text: Iggy & Scorch dealt a damn game-high 86747 hero damage, 2345 per minute on a 1296 norm.
Kira died once and scored three kills after Orb Prime, the last two in the enemy base.
Khaimera's 48797 objective damage led all ten players, opening with first blood on Legion on the duo lane.
After the 2-0 mid win, Iggy & Scorch and Gideon died, then the allied offlane outer fell.

focus.title: Every won fight ends on a structure
focus.action: After any won fight, the nearest standing tower is the next call, as after Orb Prime; and once enemy inhibitors fall, Iggy & Scorch sieges only with Legion dead or shown elsewhere.

35.7.call: Won 3-0 right after Orb Prime; the enemy mid inner fell during the fight, the mid inhibitor next, and the Core after that.

17.3.call: Two separate plays: allied deaths at mid, the Prime pit and the enemy jungle, then Kira razed the enemy duo outer and killed TwinBlast. After the first mid death, reset.

36.8.call: Kira killed Legion and Sevarog in the enemy base, then Lt. Belica took the Core. Right call: two base kills, then end on the spot.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: One death all game, 69% under the norm, to Greystone in the early duo fight. Hold the same survival standard while carrying the closing fights.
Three rotation kills, each before a prize: Shinbi before an enemy inner, Sevarog before Orb Prime, Greystone before the mid inner, inhibitor and Core. Repeat whenever duo is quiet.
c7a693fa-cc2a-4e65-83ea-c4051e786f4b: Razed four enemy structures: the offlane inner, the offlane inhibitor twice and the mid inner. Standard next game: finish every structure on an open offlane, as here.
Three deaths outside any detected fight, all in the enemy half or base, two to Legion. After each structure falls, regroup with the team before the next push.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Took the last two structures, the mid inhibitor and the Core, with 48% kill participation and 9 assists. Hold that participation as the support standard next game.
Ten wards to Greystone's 21, with zero cleared. Before each Fangtooth, sweep the pit approach if a sentry is equipped.
Four of six deaths came in the allied half before any allied tower fell, two to Greystone on the duo lane. Early, give ground when Greystone's leap is ready.
455cc4dc-c12e-4dcf-b770-f74b9408d871: Two kills each on Greystone, TwinBlast and Legion, at 1012 hero damage per minute on a 770 norm. Open grouped mid fights with long-range Void Breach.
Two early deaths to TwinBlast on mid in the allied half, both outside any detected fight. In the early mid lane, trade only after Rocket Dash is spent.
A death to Shinbi on the offlane preceded the allied mid outer falling. Once mid is pushed, ping the team before leaving for the offlane.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Eight wards against a norm of 4.6, with zero cleared. Hold the same ward pace through every long game.
A death to TwinBlast on mid in the allied half came before the only enemy Fangtooth. When Fangtooth is next, skip the mid skirmish and hold the pit.

matchup: Duo was Kira and Lt. Belica against Legion and Greystone; Greystone scored both allied deaths in the early duo fight.
Legion's 8 kills led the enemy team; Kira killed Legion once, in the enemy base before the Core fell.
Greystone's Tainted Guard cuts the attacker's healing when basic attacks hit Greystone, trimming Kira's Solaris and lifesteal healing.
build: Solaris empowers the next basic attack after an ability cast and heals Kira for a share of the damage.
Vanquisher executes heroes taken below a small health threshold, a fit for the closing kills in the enemy base.
Demolisher, finished last, ignores a share of physical armor, useful into Greystone's armor-gaining passive; earlier fights lacked Demolisher.
eternal: Vermis adds max-health physical damage on every third consecutive basic attack on one hero; Serration adds missing-health damage.
Weald is the most played Kira carry Eternal on the new patch, no edge shown; Vermis has too few games to rank.
augment: Siphoning Purge makes Purge heal Kira for a share of Purge damage dealt to heroes.
Bringer Of Mercy is the most played Kira carry augment, no edge shown; Siphoning Purge has too few games to rank.
crest: Pacifier's active dashes and empowers the next physical hit, much stronger on low-health targets, with a recast after a hero kill.
Pacifier is the most played Kira carry crest on the new patch, no edge shown. Sound keep.
improvement: No swap is proven: the field shows no edge for any Kira carry augment, Eternal or crest on the new patch.

matchup: Sevarog was the lane opponent and never scored a kill; Iggy & Scorch killed Sevarog twice early in the enemy half.
Sevarog's Phantom Rush fears, and Subjugate stuns chained targets leaving the zone.
Legion killed Iggy & Scorch three times; Legion's Rally Point knocks back and Saturation Charge slows.
build: Megacosm adds max-health and bonus-health damage on ability hits, strong into Sevarog's health-stacking souls.
Magnify cuts magical armor on heroes hit by abilities, stacking, and Gideon and Lt. Belica also deal magical damage.
World Breaker, finished last, adds tenacity and stacking magical damage; earlier fights ran without World Breaker.
eternal: Aion's spells grant mana regeneration and gold from damage on heroes; Philosopher adds periodic gold, Runic Focus magical power from mana.
Iggy & Scorch offlane has no field cell on the new patch, so no Eternal edge can be read.
augment: Hold This! permanently adds Molotov explosion damage against heroes each time the explosion hits a hero.
Too few Iggy & Scorch offlane games on the new patch to rank augments.
crest: Epoch's active enters Stasis briefly, a survival tool against Legion's damage.
Crest field data for Iggy & Scorch offlane is too thin on the new patch to rank.
improvement: If Legion again leads the enemy kills, a physical armor item buys siege survival at the cost of a damage slot.
No perk swap is proven: the thin field shows no edge either way.

matchup: Greystone and Legion each killed Lt. Belica twice in the allied half; Lt. Belica killed Greystone once.
Greystone's Stone Forged Soul heals more at low health; Tainted Scepter cuts the healing on magical damage.
Three of four Lt. Belica kills were on TwinBlast, the last in the enemy jungle in the 3-0 fight after Orb Prime.
build: Wraith Leggings, Combustion and Noxia scale ability burst behind Neural Disruptor's missing-mana or missing-health damage.
Tainted Scepter cuts healing on magical damage, useful into Greystone's ultimate and Legion's Rally Point heals.
Orion, finished last, adds attack speed from item haste; earlier fights ran without Orion.
eternal: Vesh turns a share of ability damage on heroes into damage over time; Mind Rot adds current-health damage.
Vesh is the most played Lt. Belica support Eternal, no edge shown; most played pair: Tithe of Death with Mind Rot.
augment: Combat Veteran adds movement speed and passive experience each second, scaling with hero level.
Pulsefire Rounds and Combat Veteran are a toss-up in the Lt. Belica support field; Pulsefire Rounds holds the better odds.
crest: Tranquility's active heals Lt. Belica and nearby heroes with brief damage mitigation; the Visionary passive raises the ward cap.
Tranquility leads a toss-up with Silentium in the Lt. Belica support field. Sound keep.
improvement: Pulsefire Rounds for Combat Veteran is a toss-up swap: on-hit damage on basic attacks instead of speed and experience.
No Eternal or crest change is proven by the field on the new patch.

matchup: TwinBlast was the lane opponent; Gideon and TwinBlast traded two kills each.
Legion killed Gideon three times, more than any other enemy.
build: Azure Core is one of three winning-core items; Combustion and Wraith Leggings are missing.
Soulbinder adds damage to ability hits on heroes from long range, pairing with Infinite Impact's unlimited Void Breach range.
Caustica, finished last, ignores a share of magical armor; earlier fights ran without Caustica.
eternal: Aion grants mana regeneration on casts and gold from spell damage; Bottomless Vial adds magical power from River Buffs.
Vesh is the most played Gideon mid Eternal, no edge shown; Aion has too few games to rank.
augment: Infinite Impact gives Void Breach infinite range.
Infinite Impact leads a toss-up with Event Horizon in the Gideon mid field. Sound keep.
crest: Epoch's active enters Stasis briefly, a survival answer to dives.
Soulbearer is the most played Gideon mid crest, no edge shown; Epoch has too few games to rank.
improvement: Combustion and Wraith Leggings complete the winning core: splash ability damage and bonus damage on low-health heroes, over Soulbinder's long-range bonus.
No Eternal, augment or crest swap is backed by a field edge on the new patch.

matchup: Shinbi was the jungle opponent: 3/3/4, killing Khaimera once, in the allied jungle; Khaimera never killed Shinbi.
Kills landed on Legion and TwinBlast twice each, plus Sevarog once.
Tainted Guard cuts Khaimera's healing after basic attacks on Greystone; TwinBlast's Tainted Rounds cuts the target's healing on basic attack hits.
build: Sky Splitter deals current-health damage on basic attacks, a fit for chunking Sevarog and Greystone.
Draconum was the only allied item with physical armor, against Legion's physical damage.
Void Helm, finished last, adds magical armor and boosts all healing received; earlier fights ran without Void Helm.
eternal: Lotus grants random stat gains over time and on takedowns; Early Bloom adds a level, Immaculate cuts damage at high health.
Thraex is the most played Khaimera jungle Eternal, no edge shown; Lotus has too few games to rank.
augment: Jungle Invasion adds physical power in the jungle, doubled in the enemy jungle.
Jungle Invasion leads a toss-up with Feral Ambush in the Khaimera jungle field. Sound keep.
crest: Judgement's active deals area damage around Khaimera and heals on hero hits, weaker after the first hero hit.
Iceskorn Talons is the most played Khaimera jungle crest, no edge shown; Judgement has too few games to rank.
improvement: No swap is proven: the field shows no edge for any Khaimera jungle Eternal or crest on the new patch.

threats: Heal-stacking: Greystone. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Lt. Belica) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
ourKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
ourKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

ourKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
ourKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
ourKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
ourKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
ourKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
ourKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
ourKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
ourKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Vortex Grenade → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate ult
enemyKits.winCondition: reposition with Rocket Dash and unload Ventilate from safety
enemyKits.passive: abilities grant AS + a triple-shot next basic
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to create his free-fire window
enemyKits.playAgainst: he's mobile but squishy — CC through the dash, then burst

enemyKits.combo: Phantom Rush → Subjugate root → Siphon → Colossal Blow
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Souls to snowball Siphon and lock down with the root
enemyKits.passive: ability kills grant permanent Soul stacks (HP + damage)
enemyKits.playWith: a team that converts his root into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: deny his last-hits early to starve Souls; dodge the slow Subjugate

enemyKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
enemyKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal
